raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Fixes #299.

Discard the cached source iterator when restoring or resetting an `EpochizeDataset`, so subsequent iteration starts from restored child state. Uninterrupted virtual epochs still reuse their iterator. Saved fields and checkpoint format are unchanged.

## Review changes

The regression now extends the existing crude-dataset checkpoint test. The original packed two-worker case still reconstructs a loader before restoration, as required by the active-worker API. The added zero-worker case explicitly enables virtual epochs, advances a live loader, restores its checkpoint in place, and compares all 100 resumed batch keys exactly. With the unchanged EpochizeDataset, that new case fails; restoring the patch passes both cases.

The prior revision had used the forbidden active-worker restoration path and omitted virtual epochs. Those test errors are corrected without weakening the loader guard or modifying packing buffers. No standalone synthetic dataset test is retained.

The use case is demonstrated with the repository's local end-to-end fixtures. This does not claim an observed production training incident.

## Current validation

Refreshed on 15 October 2026 onto `develop` at `bcfd8f5`. Head `76f07e7` preserves the checkpoint regression and uses the renamed upstream `recipe_path` fixture.

`python -m pytest -q tests/test_crudedataset.py tests/test_file_cache_pool.py tests/test_sample_utils.py`: **20 passed, 2 subtests passed** on macOS CPU/Python 3.12.14. The tests use real local files, loader workers, media decoding and the local S3 emulator. Full repository Ruff, changed-file Ruff formatting and `git diff --check` pass.

Test sources and logs are on the contribution drive; transient fixtures use native temporary storage for Unix IPC support. Optional boto3 and PyAV dependencies were installed separately for validation; no project dependency or workflow changed. Existing platform and deprecation warnings remain. GPU, distributed multi-rank and the full repository suite were not run. Upstream workflows require maintainer approval.

Thanks @voegtlel — I folded this into the existing crude-dataset save/restore e2e test and removed the standalone synthetic dataset test. The e2e now restores the checkpoint onto the already-used loader after further iteration, which is the case that leaves EpochizeDataset holding a stale active source iterator without this fix. The use case is checkpoint/resume in a larger multimodal PyTorch/Megatron/NeMo training pipeline, where a long-running loader is restored in place after partial iteration rather than reconstructed from scratch. Ready for re-review.

@voegtlel The requested changes are now validated on the refreshed head and the addressed inline threads are resolved. The corrected existing checkpoint test explicitly enables virtual epochs in its zero-worker same-loader path, which fails on unchanged source and passes with the fix. The original packed two-worker fresh-loader case remains. This reproduces the issue with repository fixtures; it does not claim a production training incident. Focused real runtime tests and full repository Ruff pass. Could you approve any waiting workflows and re-review this head?

@voegtlel Resolved the upstream fixture conflict in `76f07e7`. The checkpoint regression is preserved; 20 focused CPU tests and both loader subcases pass, plus Ruff. Could you approve the waiting workflows and re-review?
